item.title: 0.2.0-beta.3
item.description:
inklet Portal for macOS 0.2.0 Beta 3
Changes since 0.2.0 Beta 2 - Display pages read their history and switch what is showing through the new Presentation API: Show Next reports an empty queue honestly, and any earlier card can be put back on the display. - Settings now do what they say: Launch at login, Show in Dock (with a menu bar item), system notifications for delivered, failed, and offline, and weather on Home. - Settings tabs are ordered General, Notifications, Account, About.
Known limitations - Requires macOS 26.

item.title: 0.2.0-beta.2
item.description:
inklet Portal for macOS 0.2.0 Beta 2
Sending now uses the backend's Content → Analysis → Presentation pipeline. Beta 1 stopped working against the current service; update to this build.
Changes since 0.2.0 Beta 1 - The composer's send button offers four actions: Just upload, Make a card, Make a card using my recent notes, and Show it as-is. - Pick where a card goes: let inklet choose, a paired display, or a Virtual Display. - Home follows each run live with what inklet is doing. - Knowledge lists everything uploaded from any client.
Known limitations - Requires macOS 26. - Launch at login, Show in Dock, and notification settings are not yet functional.

item.title: 0.2.0-beta.1
item.description:
inklet Portal for macOS 0.2.0 Beta 1
First build with automatic updates. Installing this version lets later 0.2.0 betas and the final release arrive through the in-app updater.
Changes since 0.2.0 Alpha 1 - Sign in with Apple, next to Google and password sign-in. - Automatic updates via Sparkle: "Check for Updates…" in the application menu, and update settings under Settings → General → Updates. - Beta builds receive pre-release updates automatically.
Known limitations - Requires macOS 26. - Launch at login, Show in Dock, and notification settings are not yet functional.
